title: Japan Signature Journey
alt: The Sagano romantic train crossing the Hozugawa gorge, Kyoto
transport: Shinkansen bullet train, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Mount Fuji and Hakone
stops.hotel: Mitsui Garden Hotel Shiodome Italia-gai Tokyo
stops.accom: 3 nights · Super deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Shiodome, a short walk from the bay

activities.name: Mount Fuji and Hakone with the ropeway
activities.description: The fifth station on Mount Fuji, a cruise on Lake Ashi and the Hakone ropeway over the sulphur vents of Owakudani.

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing with the Skytree
activities.description: Asakusa and Senso-ji with the Nakamise shopping street, then up the Tokyo Skytree for the view across the whole city.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Three nights in Shiodome, with Mount Fuji and Hakone on the first full day and a city day up the Skytree.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Kyoto and Nara
stops.accom: 4 nights · Super deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel on the river in Osaka, with a top floor bath house

activities.name: teamLab Planets
activities.description: The barefoot digital art museum in Toyosu, where you wade through water gardens and mirrored rooms of light.

activities.name: Ginza shopping district
activities.description: An afternoon in Ginza before the train south, from the department store food halls to the quiet side street galleries.

activities.name: Kyoto with the Sagano romantic train
activities.description: A guided Kyoto day with a one way ride on the open sided Sagano romantic train along the Hozugawa river gorge.

activities.name: Nara park, Todai-ji and the Umeda Sky Building
activities.description: Todai-ji with its great bronze Buddha and the tame deer of Nara park, then the floating garden deck of the Umeda Sky Building.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Four nights on the river in Osaka, with Kyoto and the Sagano train, Nara with the Umeda Sky Building and a free day.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Four star hotels in both cities, six strong days out and the Sagano train thrown in. This is the one we book most often.
expert.tip: Breakfast is not included here, which is deliberate. Walk to a konbini or a station stand and eat like everyone else, it is half the fun.

summary: Eight days between Tokyo and Osaka in four star hotels: three nights in Shiodome with Mount Fuji, Hakone and a city day up the Skytree, then four on the river in Osaka with teamLab, Ginza, Kyoto with the Sagano romantic train, Nara and a free day.
included: Included: 7 nights in four star hotels; Shinkansen bullet train from Tokyo to Osaka; private airport transfers; Mount Fuji and Hakone tour with the Lake Ashi cruise and ropeway; Tokyo sightseeing tour with the Skytree; teamLab Planets tickets; a visit to the Ginza shopping district; Kyoto sightseeing tour with a one way Sagano romantic train ride; Nara park and Todai-ji with the Umeda Sky Building.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; all meals; travel insurance; personal expenses.
